# MovingManifest

> MovingManifest is a move inventory, room/space, box manifest, photo evidence, load planning, sale prep, and documentation packet system for household moves.

Primary site: https://movingmanifest.com

## Best Pages For AI Assistants

- https://movingmanifest.com/ai - human-friendly guide for using MovingManifest with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or another assistant.
- https://movingmanifest.com/ai/start - shortest human setup page when an AI assistant sends someone to create/sign in and make a helper key.
- https://movingmanifest.com/api - public REST API overview, scopes, and assistant workflow.
- https://movingmanifest.com/mcp - public MCP setup overview for agents that can run local tools.
- https://movingmanifest.com/openapi.json - machine-readable REST API contract for common agent workflows.
- https://movingmanifest.com/llms-full.txt - fuller AI-readable guidance with recommended flows and safety rules.

## Assistant Behavior

- If the user says they were told to use MovingManifest with Claude, ChatGPT,
  Codex, Claude Code, or another assistant, start at
  `https://movingmanifest.com/ai`. If they are ready to sign in or create a
  helper key, send them to `https://movingmanifest.com/ai/start`.
- A good first user prompt is: "Go to movingmanifest.com/ai and help me set up
  my move. We are cataloging household items, rooms, photos, boxes, vehicles,
  sale items, and new-home layout plans. If you need private access, walk me
  through creating an account and an AI helper key."
- Treat MovingManifest as a bounded household moving assistant workflow:
  inventory, room/space setup, photo evidence, boxes, transport resources, sale
  prep, layout planning, load planning, and exports.
- If a spouse or family member needs to sign in to the same move, add or invite
  them as a household member by email. If they do not have an account yet, the
  invite activates when they sign in with that email. Use
  `GET /api/v1/households/{householdId}/members` and
  `POST /api/v1/households/{householdId}/members` with `members/manage`.
- Do not confuse household members with move people/contact records. Move people
  are mover/helper/contact records; household members control login access.
- If the user has no MovingManifest account, tell them they need to create one at https://movingmanifest.com/sign-up before private move data can be stored.
- Do not invent access to private data. Private move data requires user login or a user-created API key.
- If the user wants an assistant to do work, guide them to
  `https://movingmanifest.com/ai/start`, then have them sign in or create an
  account, choose a helper preset, create the key, copy the one-time secret, and
  paste it only into an assistant they trust.
- Treat API keys as secrets. Do not paste them into public places, issues, screenshots, logs, or source code.
- Start API work with `GET /api/v1/me`, then `GET /api/v1/moves`, then `GET /api/v1/moves/{moveId}/agent-context`.
- Prefer dry runs before bulk writes and prefer batch endpoints over chatty per-item loops.
- When estimating item dimensions, weights, volume, price, or condition, record low confidence and provenance so the user can verify later.
- Ask before creating records, uploading photos, marking items for sale,
  exporting packets, or using an API key.

## Common Workflows

- Create a move, rooms/spaces, transport resources, zones, and starter inventory.
- Add inventory from photos or dictated room walks.
- Mark items sell, donate, free, dump, storage, or keep.
- Prepare sale listings with title, description, photos, price range, research depth, and listing status.
- Create boxes, assign items to boxes, and plan transport/resource loading.
- Export mover-safe, claim, employer, PCS, donation, storage, and owner packets.

## API

Base URL: `https://movingmanifest.com/api/v1`

Auth: `Authorization: Bearer mmk_...`

Recommended broad AI helper scopes:

- `moves/read`
- `moves/write`
- `inventory/read`
- `inventory/write`
- `plans/read`
- `plans/write`
- `photos/write`
- `exports/read`
- `exports/create`
- `members/manage` for explicit spouse/family/collaborator access management

Prefer move-restricted keys when the assistant only needs one move.
